node_or_batch: D-1 operator channel, R5 CI remediation over 999109c2: the inner boundary's portability (module path, launcher path) and a runtime-truthful DOTNET_STARTUP_HOOKS control
frozen_note: Every control and mutant of v1.0.1..v1.0.4 remains in force; nothing is removed or skipped. This amendment re-expresses one control by the measured runtime of the shell and adds two mutants.

root_cause.A_implementation_defect: The R5 rewrite of the inner PowerShell script (1) set PSModulePath to empty before its one module-qualified cmdlet (ConvertFrom-Json): under PowerShell 7 on Linux CI the plan read then failed (exit 1 before the node pin); (2) built the launcher path by concatenating a backslash-joined literal, which cannot exist on Linux. R4 used Join-Path and an intact module path and was green on the same runner. Windows PowerShell 5.1 masked both locally.
root_cause.B_invalid_cross_platform_expectation: The DOTNET_STARTUP_HOOKS control expected the inner script to refuse the variable on every runtime. DOTNET_STARTUP_HOOKS is a CoreCLR host feature: PowerShell 7 resolves it before any script line (CI: exit by signal), while Windows PowerShell 5.1 (.NET Framework) ignores it and the script refuses it. The expectation is re-expressed by the MEASURED runtime of the shell, not by OS.
root_cause.consequence: d1-cert-event-termination.test.ts runs the complete custody suite nested and truthfully reported the three failures; it is not changed.

positive_controls.asserts: R4-N-NODE-PIN and R4-P-BOUNDARY step (3) run the inner script end to end under PowerShell 7 on Linux CI and under Windows PowerShell 5.1 here; the pinned text restricts PSModulePath to $PSHOME/Modules and builds the launcher path with Path.Combine.

negative_controls.asserts: DOTNET_STARTUP_HOOKS never reaches the channel: on .NET Framework the script refuses it (64, names [DOTNET_STARTUP_HOOKS]); on CoreCLR the host stops before the script (non-zero exit, no script output, no node start, the hook named in the error). The runtime is measured and must be measured.

mutation_controls.description: The inner script keeps the inherited module path -> the pinned-text control RED.
The launcher path goes back to a backslash-joined literal -> the pinned-text control RED here; step (3) RED on Linux.
